styleEdits.forestPrompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: browser RPG forest terrain background. EDIT TARGET: first image, the current forest map. Preserve its exact 4:3 framing, paths, walkable clearings, tree-grove footprints and cliffs. Change ONLY the rendering style. This map must match small low-resolution monster battle sprites and a 16x32 pixel trainer: draw it as authentic COARSE low-resolution early handheld tile art on a logical 384x288 pixel grid, enlarged with NEAREST NEIGHBOR. Each logical pixel is an obvious solid square; no subpixel detail. Trees use bold dark-green one-logical-pixel outlines, only THREE flat green shades and repeated round foliage clusters. Grass is mostly large FLAT muted pale-green tiles with rare simple 2-pixel tufts. Paths are flat tan with only a few 2-pixel stones. Cliffs use three flat brown tones. Limit the whole map to about 24 colors. The previous image is FAR TOO DETAILED and painterly: remove ALL fine leaf texture, realistic grass texture, micro-dithering, gradients, atmosphere and photographic lighting. Emulate actual tiny 16x16 tile game terrain, not a high-resolution illustration about pixel art. Keep the open walkable areas calm and low-contrast so black-outlined colorful creature sprites read naturally. NO humans, NO creatures, NO monsters, NO animals, NO text, NO UI, NO logos. Original generic terrain only, not copied commercial game art.

promptTemplate: Create an ORIGINAL playable top-down 2D pixel-art safari RPG environment map, NOT a screenshot or UI. Intended as a full game terrain background for a small browser game. Landscape 4:3 composition. Match the rich crisp tile-based visual language of polished early-2000s handheld monster-catching RPGs: small square pixels, rich clustered shading, layered trees and cliffs, readable terrain with three-quarter depth, no smooth vector look, no blur, no photorealism, no 3D render. Entire image is the map, no border. Terrain: {terrain} CRITICAL: absolutely NO people, NO player, NO trainers, NO creatures, NO monsters, NO animals, NO silhouettes, NO collectible icons, NO objects pretending to be characters, NO text, NO letters, NO interface, NO logos, NO watermark. All characters will be rendered separately by the game. Keep navigation ground readable and the requested terrain footprint locations. Produce newly drawn original art; do not copy any exact commercial game screenshot, tile or character.
purpose: Original character-free pixel RPG terrain; no commercial game screenshot or character copied
